```text
# PR #2085: Patch: classify counts a `use`-only change in a non-script Rust file as a code change

Closes #2050

## What changed

`cargo jackioh classify` no longer drops `use` declarations for files that are not card scripts. `catalog.rs` gained `code_lines_with_uses` (the old comment-stripping pass, ending at the first `#[cfg(test)]`); `code_lines` is now built on it with byte-identical output, so every card `loc` is unchanged. `classify.rs`'s `code_changed` picks the normalizer by `area(path) == Area::Script`: scripts keep `catalog loc` semantics, every other `.rs`/`.ts`/`.tsx` keeps its imports. A `use`-only diff in `crates/engine/src/`, `crates/cards/src/` outside scripts, or `crates/ai/src/` now sets `play_code`/`ai` and lands in `unchecked`, so CI's `rust (classify)` runs stage 2. Comment-, layout- and test-only diffs are still no code. A unit test asserts every `AI_TOOLING` entry names a real file in `crates/ai/src/`. Recorded as ruling R2050000 (refines R1365000), with the `spec/11-rulings.md` entry, regenerated `spec/INDEX.md`, and the `classify` row in `crates/tools/README.md` updated.

## How it was tested

- `cargo test -p jackioh-tools r2050000` — 4 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-tools r1365000` — 14 passed, 0 failed; `count_loc` tests pass unchanged.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-tools` (whole crate) — 414 + 23 + 1 + 4 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo fmt --check` clean (ran `cargo fmt` once for the new tests' layout), `cargo clippy -p jackioh-tools --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean.
- `cargo jackioh spec index` (+1 INDEX line), `spec check` ok (1297 rulings, 2953 proofs), `catalog check` ok, `patches check` ok.
- Slow shared machine: the full suite took ~26 min (gate tests play real AI games) and the release build ~43 min; both completed. No pre-existing failures encountered.

## Decisions

- **New ruling R2050000, refining R1365000.** Rejected leaving the spec silent (classify refinements get rulings) and rejected rewording R1365000 (its script sentence stays true).
- **Normalizer chosen by `area(path) == Area::Script`, for `.ts`/`.tsx` too.** Rejected `.rs`-only gating; the area is what says "card script", and TypeScript has no `use` lines so both normalizers agree there.
- **`use`-line reorder counts as a change.** Rejected sorting declarations; a reorder costs only a stage 2 run that finds nothing.
- **`AI_TOOLING` checked by a unit test, not in `run`.** A rename in `crates/ai` already runs the tools tests via `scripts/ci-scope.sh`, so the stale entry fails there.

Reviewers may want a second look at the `#[cfg(test)]` cut staying "everything at or below the first one" — `crates/cards/src/lib.rs:182` is the only non-script source with a mid-file item, and everything below it is test-only, so this patch deliberately does not widen it.

### Adversarial review

Approved on round 1 of 3.
```
